title: Concept: Yarn registry configured over cleartext
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a Yarn registry URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Packages and authentication headers cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute the tarball the lockfile recorded.
risk: Packages and authentication headers cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can substitute the tarball the lockfile recorded.
